scope_of_work_and_exclusions: DEMOLITION SCOPE OF WORK (Disassemble Dynamics)
1. Complete interior demolition of all items in the building except roof drains above ceiling, main MDP and panels; remove interior partitions to deck, +/-850 LF (A1 Demo Note)
2. Remove drywall on exterior walls down to fur channel, +/-3,500 SF (A1 Demo Note)
3. Remove ceilings and grid throughout, incl. M100 data room ceiling only, +/-7,700 SF (A1, M100 Note)
4. Remove existing floor finishes throughout, +/-7,590 SF (A1 Demo Note)
5. Remove doors, frames and hardware, +/-40 EA; casework, countertops and reception desk, +/-100 LF (A1)
6. Remove plumbing fixtures, +/-30 EA, after capping by plumbing contractor (A1)
7. Remove light fixtures, devices, conduit and wire back to the nearest junction box; HVAC ductwork, diffusers, grilles and hangers (A1 Demo Note)
8. Remove existing storefront and glazing at new entrance and center section for new exterior door, +/-60 LF (A1, A1.1)
9. Remove existing curb and gutter 274 LF, asphalt pavement 1,574 SF, concrete 489 SF (Site Demo Notes 1, 2, 3)
10. Remove existing trees incl. stump grinding, 8 EA (Site Demo Note 4)
11. Protect X-Ray 120, MDP/panels and roof drains in place; legally dispose of all debris; leave broom clean
ALTERNATES
Alt #1: Remove exterior CMU walls at angled entries, +/-67 LF x +/-12' (A1 'Demo exterior CMU wall')
Alt #2: Sawcut asphalt / concrete / curb at site removal limits
Alt #3: Grind / remove mastic after flooring removal
DEMOLITION EXCLUSIONS
- X-Ray 120 (no demo this room); MDP, panels and roof drains to remain
- All patching, repair, floor leveling and prep for new finishes; utility disconnects/caps by trades
- Removal of conduit/wire beyond the nearest junction box or back to panel
- Shoring limited to non-load-bearing masonry; load-bearing shoring, design and engineering excluded; lintels/jamb reinforcement excluded
- Hazardous materials survey/abatement; erosion control, grading, utilities and new site work
- Terms: plans only, zero retainage, net 30, price valid 90 days; additional mobilization $3,250
FLOORING SCOPE (Wayne's Carpet Plus)
1. Furnish & install Mohawk 559 Anodized Lapis carpet tile in rooms per Finish Schedule incl. corridors, +/-4,948 SF
2. Furnish & install Flexco Natural Elements American Cherry 610 LVT in rooms per Finish Schedule, +/-3,147 SF
3. Furnish & install 2x2 sheet ceramic shower floor tile in ADA Tlt 124, +/-13 SF (color with PMG)
4. Floor prep - patch/skim allowance; transition strips between dissimilar floors (max 1/8")
FLOORING EXCLUSIONS
- Wood base WM618 / WM725, quarter round, chair rail and crown (trim carpentry); moisture mitigation beyond allowance; furniture moving
